website.notes: No detailed pipeline page; corporate site describes ddRNAi platform and OPMD program

pipeline.modality: AAV9-delivered ddRNAi 'silence and replace' gene therapy (codon-optimized PABPN1 + two shmiRs)
pipeline.target: PABPN1 (silence mutant + replace with codon-optimized variant)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (with Royal Holloway University of London origin patents assigned to Benitec)

indications.trial_design: Single-arm, open-label, sequential dose-escalation; intramuscular pharyngeal injection; 52-week post-dosing follow-up
key_milestones: Orphan Drug Designation US and EU

excluded_legacy_terminated: BB-401 (Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Phase 2 completed 2018, NCT03433027 — legacy program no longer in active development)
